# 5. Feedback Purpose {.unnumbered}

*Is my feedback preference developmental or summative?*

## The Mindset(s) {.unnumbered}

- **Surface ↔ Substantive**: whether feedback addresses presentation and mechanics or the
  underlying reasoning.
  - *Survey item:* items pending.
- **Developmental ↔ Summative**: whether feedback is given to improve the work or to
  judge it.
  - *Survey item:* items pending.

**Polarity:** Surface ↔ Substantive; Developmental ↔ Summative.

**Measure:** Dual-Role Feedback Orientation Scale · giving-feedback (2025); Teachers'
Conceptions of Assessment · Improvement vs. Accountability (Brown, 2006).

::: {.callout-note}
## Measure pending
Both instruments are copyrighted and have not yet been sourced.
:::

## Reflect and Plan

::: {.callout-warning}
## Journal
- **Score:** How does reflecting on your score help you think about who you are as a mentor?
- **Behavior:** To be the best mentor you can be, what is one new thing you will try to do this week for mentees and/or your team?
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
## During Class
Make note of whether your feedback this week is meant to develop the work or to judge it.
:::
